create_HTML_report: create an HTML report object with a web directory and title using the HTML class
add_images_to_HTML: add a row of images with captions and links to the HTML report using add_images
add_header_to_HTML: add an h3 header section to the HTML report using add_header
save_HTML_report: save the generated HTML document to an index.html file in the web directory
get_image_dir_from_HTML: get the images subdirectory path from an HTML report object using get_image_dir
